notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only status evidence is the Removed tag on the Eastern US list. No source gives a build, design, height or removal date, so the record's null design and height stay null. Wikipedia is used for the community name only, not for the lookout. The TopoZone listing is a map database point and says nothing about whether a structure stands.
